messages:
maria: Draft announce post + benchmark narrative is ready for review. Need eng signoff on changelog text, canary timing, and any explicit model fallback language before we lock the embargo. Can we sync here? :eyes:
kevin: Paste the exact changelog snippet and the planned canary windows here and we can confirm. Also: do we need to call out different behavior for Dedicated vs Hosted?
maria: Draft links: announce doc (private): https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/drafts/announce-2026-apr.md
maría: Webinar proposed: Wed 04/01 16:00 PT. Panel + demo. Slides in the doc.
tara: Docs will go live at /docs/release-notes once you give final text. I can publish today if content is locked. Please include a short TL;DR for the top of the page.
josh: Product: recommend we mention routing/fallback briefly. Suggested changelog snippet you can paste: ```- canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h
- fallback: automatic to lightweight-quant variant when capacity constrained
- rollout_policy: release-2026-04-canary-v2
```
josh: If you want the policy tag in copy use `release-2026-04-canary-v2` so SRE can correlate.
diane: Sales ops question: webinar registrants should be tagged with UTM and SFDC queue. Which SFDC queue? We usually use Inbound > Product > MLPlatform. Also need lead_priority mapping.
maria: Proposed UTM: ?utm_campaign=april_release&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email
maria: SFDC target queue: inbound-ml-evangelists. Add product_tag=ReleaseApr26 and lead_priority=high for paid channel registrants.
diane: OK will map that. Also include `ad_channel=paid` param for paid ads so we can auto-prioritize.
kevin: Canary schedule (engineering approved): start Wed 04/01 00:00 UTC at 10% traffic to variant `v2-quant-lite`, hold 8h, ramp to 50% Thu 04/02 08:00 UTC, full by Fri 04/03 02:00 UTC if no regressions. Automatic rollback goes to `v1-stable` if errors spike.
kevin: We'll hand over final changelog URL after Tara publishes. For now use staging URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/apr-2026-draft.md
tara: :thumbsup: I can publish at 18:00 PT and will paste the final /docs link here. I'll add the TL;DR and the short policy note for product.
maria: Marketing needs final go/no-go by EOD so we can set embargo lift to Thu 04/02 09:00 PT. Please react if your lane is green.
josh: :thumbsup: I'll add the fallback blurb to product notes and verify wording with eng.
diane: :thumbsup: Sales ops can wire SFDC/UTM mappings as soon as final UTMs confirmed.
kevin: :thumbsup: Eng ok with schedule. SRE will monitor the canary and will notify this channel if any rollback action occurs.
deploy-bot: Canary created: name=release-apr-2026-canary, variant=v2-quant-lite, initial_traffic=10%, monitor_url=/ops/metrics/release-apr-2026
maría: Great work team 97 I'll update the announce doc with the final staging changelog and post final links once Tara publishes. :rocket:
